data.one_liner: Material Design app intro screens with animations and circular page reveal.
data.what_it_does: Provides fully responsive introductory or onboarding screens with custom page view models, animations, circular page reveals, and buttons for skip, back, next, and done.
use_when: You need to build an onboarding or intro screen flow for a new user.
You want material design app intros with circular page reveal animations.
avoid_when: You are building a custom multi-step form wizard that requires complex state management per step.
You need deep custom routing or navigation outside of a simple intro sequence.
strengths: Easy addition of pages using PageViewModel.
Includes cool animations and circular page reveals out of the box.
Responsive design with support for custom fonts and styling.
weaknesses: Adding more than four pages may cause overlapping between page icons and the skip button.
Limited to intro screens and simple onboarding flows.
